full_page.content:
1927, December
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original notes by the Servant of God Fr. Solanus Casey OFM Cap. (his notebook No. 4)
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 1
Emma Mc Dermott - Goiter poisoning
Franklyn Tribbey - confession after year - enrolled two days before Clarence Diegel - scrupulous boy of 14 Criple - boy Hoyt S. Para- dise Bay City
Dec. 3rd Edw'd Jitnik Enrolled Oct. 28 in cast - paralised - comes Dec. 3rd O.K.
Dec. 4th Mrs. Verdon (56) 318 E. Gr. Blvd. Enrolled four times annually for ulsers of stomach - 8 - 10 yrs August Enrolled perpetually relief started at once .... In thanksgiving - went daily to Holy Com. for two months - during October in Hon. of Mary Queen of the Rosary - Nov. for the Poor Souls.
Page 2 Dec. 6th Mrs. C. Boran (n. cath.) fears blindness 11703 Charle Voix Mr. Robert - fears serious operation - Enrolled perpetually To-night. Mrs. M. Reichenbach Jondies - 8 weeks
Dec. 12 Elmer Dillon - In Fords Epyliplic .. James Molloy Poor - Cast on Leg. Victim of "Fortune - teller - ! daughter-in-law.
Mrs. Harris
Dec. 15 Goitre reported - "gone in 3 weeks entirely" - Enrolled perpetually To-day, as promised.
Lady - Lawyer - away from confession since graduated in 1925 En -. rolled in June - seen shortly after at comunion - away on Vacation.
Page 3 Dec. 18 in 1926 Sr. Joachim - in Famous Mayo Br. 4 month June to October - Now teaching music
